workflows.title: Boogu Base
workflows.description: Free Boogu Base text-to-image ComfyUI workflow. Create AI character art, cartoon images and AI influencer photos from a prompt.
notes: Replace prompt placeholders and supply your own input images, video or audio before running.
workflows.body:
Boogu is an open-source image model for creative, stylized and realistic images. The base model gives you the most detail and control.

**Great for:**
- AI character and cartoon art
- Stylized AI influencer images
- Creative concept images

### How it works
1. Write your prompt.
2. Run it with the default settings.
3. Add LoRAs for your character or style.

### Make it yours with LoRAs
This workflow supports LoRAs. Grab character, style, anime or cartoon LoRAs from [CivitAI](https://civitai.com) or [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co), drop them into the LoRA loader, and keep your AI character looking the same in every shot.

workflows.title: Qwen Image Edit 2511
workflows.description: Edit images with text using Qwen Image Edit 2511. Change outfits, poses and backgrounds of your AI influencer or character in ComfyUI.
notes: Replace prompt placeholders and supply your own input images, video or audio before running.
workflows.body:
Qwen Image Edit lets you change an image just by describing the edit. Load up to three reference images and say what to change.

**Great for:**
- Changing an AI influencer's outfit, pose or background
- Combining a character with a product or place
- Fixing and restyling cartoon art

### How it works
1. Load your reference images.
2. Describe the edit, like "put her in a red dress on a beach".
3. Run it.

### Fast or best quality?
With the Lightning LoRA, Qwen needs only 8 steps at CFG 1, so images come out much faster. Without it, use about 25 steps and a CFG above 1: generation takes longer, but quality is noticeably better.
